title: System humanist
license: No font files bundled; host OS faces apply.
scriptCoverage: Use actual platform text-size preferences. Measure fallback glyphs for target languages.
fit: A friendly unobtrusive system whose identity comes from composition.
rules: Treat sizes as candidate browser baselines, not native point/sp prescriptions.
Scale and reflow content at enlarged text; do not truncate essential action labels.
Keep native framework/platform text scaling enabled.
Use font-display behavior and subset budgets appropriate to the actual chosen files.
metricsReview: Candidate role sizes and line-height ratios; measure x-height, fallback, actual glyph coverage and enlarged text in the target runtime before adoption.
